# Vendored build dependencies

- Better-Endfield ABI headers: https://github.com/Dr-hydra/Better-Endfield, local upstream commit `dd7131b44cd6f99bdcd67386cd8a778249c1e396`. Headers copied without changes. Upstream license text: better-endfield/LICENSE (AGPL-3.0).
- nlohmann JSON: header and MIT license preserved in nlohmann/.

These files make the build independent of an adjacent BEM checkout. No BEM Host binary, private model or EFMI mod is included. This inventory does not resolve the licensing scope of the complete EAI module.
